svg.title: Milestone criteria and actions wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / MILESTONES / RETIREMENT
Criteria combine metrics with AND or OR.
Completion is checked each year. A before-age or before-year criterion can complete early.
An action applies from the completion year, never earlier.
Criteria store metric, comparator, value, and timing. AND requires every row; OR requires one.
Actions change income, spending, location, or tax from the completion year. No action fires in a year the milestone
Relocation changes jurisdiction and state tax from the completion year and leaves earlier years untouched.
The result line proves the rule: $900,000 at 55 does not complete; completion waits for 2047.
